verdict: Kuey teow soup is much more weight-loss friendly. It has less than half the calories, but almost the same protein.
why: Kuey teow soup is an estimated 350 kcal. Char kuey teow is an estimated 740 kcal, a difference of almost 400 kcal.
Kuey teow soup fat is only an estimated 8 g. Char kuey teow is an estimated 37 g, because of the oil, lard or vegetable oil, and fried egg.
Protein is almost the same, an estimated 20 g vs 22 g. So you get almost the same fullness with far fewer calories.
Soup helps you eat more slowly. Oily, tasty char kuey teow is easier to finish quickly.
when_a: Char kuey teow suits an occasional meal when you're really craving it. Eat one plate, no need to feel guilty.
when_b: Kuey teow soup suits a regular lunch or dinner, including workdays.
tip: For kuey teow soup, ask for extra fishballs, chicken or vegetables. For char kuey teow, ask for a small size and less oil, and consider sharing.

faq.q: Is the soup high in calories?
faq.a: Usually low. But if the soup is oily or has lots of fried shallots, the calories go up a little.

faq.q: Can I eat char kuey teow without ruining my progress?
faq.a: Yes. One plate doesn't decide your results. What matters is how often, and what you eat on the other days.
